summary.text: Felicia Simone Robinson represents District 104 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected in 2020 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Robinson is an educator who lives in Miami Gardens, served on the Miami Gardens city council from 2010 to 2018, and was the city's vice mayor from 2014 to 2016.
Robinson holds a B.S. in mathematics from Tuskegee University (1994) and degrees from the University of Miami (M.S., 2005) and Barry University (Ed.S., 2013).
